scenes.title: Data Profiling
scenes.subtitle: Understanding your data before you trust it
scenes.narration: Data profiling analyzes a dataset to summarize its structure, content, and statistics so you understand it before building on it.

scenes.heading: What profiling reveals
bullets: Null rates and completeness per column
Min, max, mean, and outliers for numbers
Patterns and formats in text fields
scenes.narration: Profiling shows the distribution of values so you can spot skew and dominant categories. It reports null rates per column, exposing completeness gaps at a glance. It measures cardinality to reveal candidate keys, summarizes numeric ranges to find outliers, and detects text patterns that hint at format problems.

scenes.heading: How profiling drives quality
steps: Scan the dataset to compute statistics
Turn findings into expectations and rules
Automate those rules as ongoing checks
scenes.narration: Profiling starts by scanning the data to compute per-column statistics automatically. You then review the profile looking for surprises, such as an unexpectedly high null rate or an out-of-range value. Those findings become concrete expectations, which you then automate as recurring quality checks.

scenes.heading: Quick profiling in pandas
scenes.narration: This loop walks every column and records its type, null rate, distinct count, and most frequent value. The null rate immediately surfaces completeness issues, while the distinct count hints at keys and categorical fields. Dumping the result as readable JSON gives a compact profile you can review or diff over time.

scenes.text: Profile first: let the data tell you its shape, then codify what you learn into automated expectations.
scenes.narration: Profiling replaces guesswork with evidence about how a dataset actually behaves. The statistics you gather become the foundation for meaningful validation rules.
